description: Smart right-to-left (RTL) for Persian, Arabic and Hebrew messages in every AI agent environment: Antigravity, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Kiro and VSCodium. Code and terminals always stay LTR.
cfg.mode: Direction mode for the RTL engine.
cfg.mode.smart: Detect the direction of each message from its own content (recommended)
cfg.mode.rtl: Force all text blocks to right-to-left
cfg.mode.ltr: Force all text blocks to left-to-right
cfg.inputs: Automatic direction for text inputs (dir=auto) — typing Persian moves the caret to the right side.
cfg.monaco: Try to right-align the Monaco chat composer when the text is Persian (never touches the code editor or terminal).
cfg.extraCSS: Custom CSS, e.g. a Persian font like Vazirmatn.
cfg.container: Extra selector for message containers (for compatibility with new chat UIs).
cfg.exclude: Selectors that must never be touched.
